player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} Quantum Tic Tac Toe a na re.
Nanhte symbol '{symbol}' re, nanhte move numbers {parity} re (e.g., X1, X3 shi O2, O4).

Mungdan: Classical marks (superpositions kaw nna) thum kaw nna shang kaw nna nanhte win re.

Kadai Mung:
- Turn kaba, format '[a,b]' nna empty squares kaw nna spooky mark 2 kaw nna re.
- Marks kaw nna entangled re, 'X1 / X1' shi 'O4 / O4' kaw nna label re.
- Square kaba collapsed (solidified) kaw nna spooky marks kaw nna re nna.

Collapse Rule:
- Move kaba cycle kaw nna entanglement graph kaw nna, auto collapse re.
- Cycle kaw nna spooky mark kaw nna classical mark kaw nna 2 position kaw nna re.
- Dependent spooky marks kaw nna collapse re.

Victory:
- Game kaba player kaba 3 classical marks kaw nna shang kaw nna re.
- Player 2 kaba line kaw nna same collapse kaw nna, max move number kaba lower kaw nna win re.

Example move: '[0,4]' kaw nna spooky mark kaw nna cells 0 shi 4 kaw nna re.

invalid_move.wrong_format: N htuk ai format. "[a,b]" hpe lang u.
invalid_move.invalid_cells: N jaw ai (sh) duplicate cell index ni hpe lang na matu.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Hkum hkrang gaw n-gun yawm mat sai.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} kaba symbol kaw nna superposition kaw nna cells {pos_a} shi {pos_b} kaw nna re.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition kaw nna resolved re. Cell ({r}, {c}) kaba {symbol} re.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition kaw nna last cell kaw nna resolved re. Cell ({r}, {c}) kaba {symbol} re.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition kaw nna resolved re. Cell ({r}, {c}) kaba {symbol} re.

outcome.win: Player {player_id} gaw, masat dingsat ni hpe lu la ai hte dang kau sai!
outcome.draw: Dai gaw dang ai hku byin wa sai.
